question:
Seven boxes C, D, E, M, N, O and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

Only D is kept above C. Only E is kept between C and M. Only P is kept below N. How many boxes are kept between O and P?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes, C, D, E, M, N, O, and P, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only D is kept above C.
 
• Only E is kept between C and M.
 
• Only P is kept below N.
 
• The number of boxeskept between O and P is N.
 
• The final arrangement is 

 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 
 
M

 
 
 

 
 
O

 
 
 

 
 
N

 
 
 

 
 
P

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
